rationale.text: The page has a title element in head with no content. The glossary defines the page title as the content of the title tag, and the wording asks whether the page has a title; it does not say whether an element with no content gives the page one. The custom check record leaves this open and answers cannot_tell (its step 4); only the record supports this branch. The requirement is unresolved. axe's document-title faults on an empty document.title, through an evidence-only link, so at full the reason is alternative_unresolved (an unresolved requirement with a reported fault); at fail_only it is needs_review, not_enabled.
